assets.purpose: Cheap single-reference test to validate the environment plate holds up in motion on Mini before spending on the full multi-reference shot.
assets.approval_note: Verified frame-by-frame: stationary van, falling snow, no drift, no defects, no label bleed.

assets.prompt_structure: Reference-role preamble (@Image1/@Image2) + timestamped action-block timeline (6 beats, [00:00-00:03] ... [00:13-00:14]) + inline continuity constraints + closing dash negative-prompt line
assets.approval_note: Tony: 'I'll grade that a C. It passes.' Verified frame-by-frame: correct left-to-right crossing path, calf stays antler-free and correctly proportioned throughout, van never visibly rendered (matches no-exit constraint), road clear at end, no duplicate moose or stray subjects. This is the real Mini pilot-test result -- first full multi-reference action shot on Mini for this pipeline. Passable, real-world usable result, not an A-tier result like Shot 02's standard-tier equivalent -- an honest quality/cost tradeoff, not a defect list.

issues.note: Overall grade C vs. the standard-tier Shot 02's A -- Mini's visual fidelity is a real, accepted step down in exchange for ~80-90% cost reduction. No specific itemized defects called out by Tony beyond the grade itself.
